tools.description: List wireless UCI configuration and runtime status without exposing Wi-Fi credentials.
tools.name: get_wifi_config

tools.description: Get the Active Wireless Interface List of this OpenWrt device.
tools.name: get_active_wlan_if_list

tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to edit existing Wi-Fi access point settings. This tool takes no arguments and does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.
tools.name: update_wifi_config

tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to remove an existing Wi-Fi access point configuration. This tool takes no arguments and does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.
tools.name: delete_wifi_config

tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to add a Wi-Fi access point configuration. The band argument must be exactly 2G, 5G, or 6G. The tool returns an error if no radio for the requested band is configured. This tool does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.

properties.name: band
properties.description: Wi-Fi band: exactly 2G for 2.4 GHz, 5G for 5 GHz, or 6G for 6 GHz.

tools.name: add_wifi_config
